verdict.rationale: The axis applies because LiveKit Agents offers a hosted LiveKit Cloud deployment option, but the pack contains no published per-minute or usage rates and no cost-per-call estimator. The only item from the pricing page describes a deployment-rollback feature, not prices. A community post notes users had no way to measure cost per call, which also gives no evidence of published pricing.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see published per-minute or usage pricing and estimate cost per call before committing
